name: Reviewer Agent
description: Cross-validates all agent outputs, checks for contradictions, and produces calibrated meta-confidence using OpenAI Agents SDK

skills.name: Contradiction Check
skills.description: Cross-agent contradiction detection: quant vs analytics trend, quant vs RAG sentiment, macro vs quant signal
examples: Check for contradictions between quant and analytics for AAPL

skills.name: Source Verification
skills.description: Verify each agent's output for internal consistency and plausible value ranges
examples: Verify DCF upside calculation is consistent

skills.name: Confidence Scoring
skills.description: Aggregate per-agent confidence, agreement score, data quality, and meta-confidence
examples: Score overall confidence across all agents for NVDA

skills.name: Recommendation Validation
skills.description: Gather supporting and contradicting evidence for the quant recommendation and rate evidence strength
examples: Validate the BUY recommendation for TSLA

skills.name: Structured Review
skills.description: Produce a structured meta-review with verdict, flags, and calibrated confidence for the orchestrator
examples: Produce a complete review for AAPL analysis
